facts.content: Use US English spelling (color, favorite, center, organize, defense).
Call the sport soccer, not football.
Match previews: use the competition name from the fixture.
Match previews: keep the body to at most 80 words.
Match previews: always state the kickoff time with its time zone, for example 7:00 PM CT.
Match previews: energetic and direct; short sentences.
Club site header menu order: Home, News, Fixtures, Standings, Squad, Videos.
Club site: when the club has a soccer team, give it Fixtures, Squad and Standings pages. Skip Statistics unless the brief asks for it.
